[[Destructive Hornbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[hornbow]] dropped by [[Storm of Destruction]], a [[boss]] in [[Riven Earth]].

== Stats ==
:[[Piercing damage|Piercing Dmg]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Lengthens [[Poison]] [[duration]] on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:Health +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as a [[Dead Bow]].

==Replica==

**[[Hornbow]] from collector [[Maddison]]
**[[Stoneshard Hornbow]] from collector [[Charmamani]] or crafters [[Aksah]], [[Asiri]], [[Hahbe]] or [[Kol Swordshanks]]

==Unique counterparts==
[[Seedborn Flatbow]], [[Imperial Dragon Bow]], [[Elswyth's Longbow]], [[Johon's Longbow]], [[Nundak's Recurve Bow]], [[Bow of the Kinslayer]], and [[Tenezel's Shortbow]] have stats identical to this item; however, they are different bow classes.
